text: In 1901 Edith Fixture was elected president of the Ladies' Library Association. “We will have a library in this town if I must carry the books myself,” she told the meeting. It is not known whether the town agreed. She had within three years become one of the few women in the town to own the building she did business in. The council voted to fund the library in 1905. The reading room is currently a museum.
